principles.title: Prepare before launch
principles.description: Make save, mod and environment choices in a desktop app before Farming Simulator starts.

principles.title: Save-specific by design
principles.description: Treat each Farming Simulator save as its own managed setup rather than forcing one global configuration onto every map.

principles.title: Use proven SGJ systems
principles.description: Reuse existing SGJ concepts and APIs where practical instead of duplicating working game-side logic.

capabilities.title: Mod folder management
capabilities.description: Create, select and organise separate mod folders for different saves, maps and testing scenarios.

capabilities.title: Save-game generator
capabilities.description: Create the initial save structure and player-defined setup before the first in-game load.

capabilities.title: First-load world setup
capabilities.description: A lightweight FS25 bootstrap component applies the requested starting world when the generated save is loaded for the first time.

capabilities.title: Crop policy at creation
capabilities.description: Expose a deliberately simplified CCO-style setup so crop rules can be chosen before the save begins.

capabilities.title: Full field regeneration
capabilities.description: Reset and regenerate the map on first load from the app-defined configuration instead of trying to infer which initial fields the player should preserve.

capabilities.title: Save inspection and diagnostics
capabilities.description: Bring useful SGJ utilities together for mod-version comparison, active-mod review and save troubleshooting.
